papers.title_en: Dual-Scale Condition-Shift Editing for Robust Real-World Image Demoiréing
papers.authors: Shiyang Zhou, Haijin Zeng, Congpei Qiu, Zhengcen Li, Ping Chen, Xiangming Wang, Zheng Li, Yongyong Chen, Jingyong Su
papers.evidence: 借助流匹配生成先验实现图像去摩尔纹的保内容编辑框架
papers.tldr: 屏幕翻拍图像去摩尔纹易受频率、颜色和空间分布差异影响，低频色带与高频条纹共存时尤难。DemoiréEdit将预训练流匹配编辑器的自然图像先验迁移到去摩尔纹，采用端点监督训练与双尺度条件偏移策略，先低分辨率全局校正再全分辨率细节恢复。在DailyMoiré130上残余摩尔纹面积最低，盲测总体质量偏好达71.3%，并在FHDMi/UHDM降低残余置信度、提升MUSIQ。该工作为真实场景鲁棒去摩尔纹提供了内容保持的编辑式框架与挑战性基准。
papers.abstract_en: Robust demoiréing of screen-recaptured images remains challenging: moiré varies in frequency, color, and spatial support across display-camera pairs and capture conditions. Dedicated restoration networks trained on finite paired data struggle with this diversity, especially when low-frequency color banding and high-frequency stripes co-occur. We present DemoiréEdit, a content-preserving editing framework that adapts the natural-image prior of a pretrained flow-matching editor to demoiréing. First, an endpoint-supervised training objective supplements velocity matching with pixel, perceptual, and frequency-domain restoration losses. Second, a dual-scale condition-shift strategy performs global correction at low resolution, then refines the image at full resolution by shifting the denoising condition from the first-stage output to the original input for detail recovery. We also introduce DailyMoiré130, a benchmark of challenging moiré in everyday screen photography, comprising 130 smartphone captures across diverse displays with low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference. On the challenging DailyMoiré130 benchmark, our method achieves the lowest residual moiré area and receives 71.3% overall-quality preference in a blind Best-of-7 study with 31 participants. We also evaluate on paired FHDMi/UHDM, reducing residual moiré confidence by 47.1%/9.3% and increasing MUSIQ by 4.3%/2.0% over the best baseline for each metric.

papers.title_en: Dancing Diffusion: Learning Continuous Programs for Image Generation and Editing
papers.authors: Cui Enhe, Jinyue Yang, Bojian Yin, Guoqi Li
papers.evidence: 面向图像生成与编辑的扩散轨迹潜程序条件控制
papers.tldr: 扩散模型多步去噪轨迹通常由同一指令控制，难以对单个操作寻址。Dancing Diffusion为每段去噪时间步分配连续条件块，将文本条件编译为可执行潜在程序，并由固定预训练生成器分段执行。在SANA上，复用已执行前缀比从噪声重生成保留更多场景，学习条件比原生提示切换保留更多背景，并提升生成质量。该工作把单指令轨迹转为可寻址操作程序，为扩散模型的结构化中间计算奠定基础。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models generate samples through a multi-step denoising trajectory, yet condition every step on the same instruction, so the trajectory cannot be addressed at the level of individual operations. We introduce Dancing Diffusion, which assigns each span of timesteps a dedicated continuous condition block and thereby turns conditioning into a latent program. A compiler maps text features into this program, and a fixed pretrained generator executes its blocks over successive sampling intervals. The trajectory can then dance, keeping its executed history while its continuation is redirected. A shared prefix is executed once and reused, and a later operation is rewritten while content fixed by earlier operations is preserved. The compiler is trained through the images it produces, with visual feedback on both the requested change and the retained content. On SANA, reusing an executed prefix preserves markedly more of the scene than regenerating from noise at a similar strength of edit, learned conditions preserve more background than native prompt switching from the same saved state, and the learned program improves generation quality over native SANA. Later branches weaken the edit, which leaves semantic control over individual operations limited. By converting a single-instruction trajectory into a program of addressable operations, Dancing Diffusion lays a foundation for structured intermediate computation in diffusion models.

papers.title_en: One Evaluation Is Enough: Inversion-Free Image Editing with Trajectory Correction
papers.authors: Lifan Jiang, Taiyang Chen, Senlin cheng, Bolei Xu, Xiaobo Li, Can Ye, Dehai Zhao, Deng Cai, Boxi Wu
papers.evidence: 基于单步轨迹校正的免反演图像编辑
papers.tldr: 真实图像编辑通常依赖反演与迭代采样，而高效一步编辑器需在多个噪声层估计并平均编辑场。论文提出端点校准传输ECT：仅在一个共享噪声状态做一次源-目标查询，同时获得语义切线与干净端点位移，先积分切线得到名义一步传输，再用端点位移约束校正长程外推。方法无需反演、轨迹积分或迭代优化，可直接用于预训练VP一步生成器，在基准上以极短编辑时间稳定提升编辑质量。
papers.abstract_en: Real-image editing commonly relies on inversion and iterative sampling, while efficient one-step editors often stabilize a large update by estimating and averaging editing fields at multiple noise levels. We ask a stricter question: is a single temporal field evaluation sufficient for reliable inversion-free editing? Our answer rests on a previously underused duality in a variance-preserving (VP) one-step model: one source-target query at a shared noisy state simultaneously determines a local angular semantic tangent and a clean endpoint displacement. We integrate the tangent over the analytically known remaining VP angle to obtain a nominal one-step transport, and use the endpoint displacement to correct its long-horizon extrapolation through a constrained projection. This transport-first, correction-second construction yields Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT), a closed-form, training-free editor requiring only one noise level, two text conditions packed into one denoiser batch, and one latent update. ECT requires no image inversion, trajectory integration, second temporal observation, or iterative optimization, and can be directly applied to pretrained epsilon-prediction VP one-step generators. Across the reported benchmark settings, ECT delivers stable gains in editing quality within an extremely short editing time.

papers.title_en: CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Dong-hwi Kim, Chaewon Moon, Hojun Song, Dongbeom Kim, Junyeong Jang, Aro Kim, Gahyeon Kim, Heejung Choi, Jehee Kim, Gianella Cravioto, Sohyun Lee, Gyeongjin Choi, EunHye Jeong, Soo Ye Kim, Jaehyup Lee, Sang-hyo Park
papers.evidence: 基于扩散模型的多视图修复以实现几何一致的3D重建
papers.tldr: 有损压缩会引入跨视角几何不一致，破坏特征匹配、稠密对应与相机参数估计，进而影响三维重建和新视角合成。为此，作者提出 CompMVR，一种压缩感知的多视角扩散复原框架，联合细化压缩视图并利用压缩先验与跨视角对应保持几何一致性，同时构建压缩数据集用于系统评测。实验覆盖多数据集、编解码器和压缩级别，在复原质量及新视角合成、位姿估计、视图匹配等下游任务上均取得提升。该工作将压缩多视角复原确立为独立问题，凸显其对有损压缩下三维重建的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: Real-world 3D reconstruction pipelines often rely on multi-view images degraded by lossy compression. While compression artifacts have been extensively studied in single-image or video restoration, their impact on multi-view geometry remains largely overlooked. In this work, we identify compression-induced cross-view geometric inconsistency as a critical failure mode, where view-dependent artifacts disrupt feature matching, dense correspondence, camera parameter estimation, and downstream 3D reconstruction tasks such as novel view synthesis. To address this problem, we propose CompMVR, a compression-aware multi-view diffusion restoration framework that jointly refines compressed views while preserving cross-view consistency, and construct compressed datasets for systematic evaluation. Unlike conventional restoration methods that optimize each image independently for 2D perceptual quality, CompMVR leverages learned compression priors and cross-view correspondence to recover visual details while improving geometric reliability across views. Experiments across diverse datasets, codecs, and compression levels demonstrate gains in restoration quality and downstream 3D tasks, including novel-view synthesis, camera pose estimation, and view matching. These results establish compressed multi-view restoration as a distinct problem and highlight its importance for 3D reconstruction under lossy compression. Code and data for this paper are available at https://mchaewon.github.io/CompMVR-project-page/.

papers.title_en: HiFiPix: Bringing High-Fidelity Real-World Super-Resolution Back to Pixel Space
papers.authors: Wenjie Li, Du Chen, Hui Wang, Linlong Fan, Youwei Lv, Zeyi Chen, Zehan Chen, Jinwei Chen, Heng Guo, Zhanyu Ma, Qingnan Fan
papers.evidence: 面向真实世界超分辨率的像素空间扩散框架
papers.tldr: 扩散式真实世界图像超分受VAE潜表示信息损失制约，重建保真度不足；像素空间扩散虽可避免压缩，却面临块边界伪影与生成能力退化。HiFiPix构建像素空间Real-ISR框架，以跨尺度小波判别器和Mixup对比自蒸馏抑制伪影，并提出选择性LoRA剪枝缓解生成-保真权衡。实验表明其在重建精度与感知质量上大幅超越潜空间SOTA。该工作将高保真真实世界超分重新拉回像素空间。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution suffers from limited reconstruction fidelity due to information loss in VAE-based latent representations. Recently, pixel-space diffusion models offer a promising high-faithfulness alternative by avoiding latent compression, but adapting them to Real-ISR remains challenging due to inherent patch boundary artifacts and degraded generative capability. To address the issues and maximize the potential of pretrained pixel-space diffusion models, we propose HiFiPix, a pixel-space Real-ISR framework capable of ultra high-fidelity reconstruction and fine-grained visual generation effects. To suppress patch boundary artifacts, we penalize unrealistic high-frequency periodic components with a Cross-Scale Wavelet Discriminator (CWSD) for image-level supervision, and Mixup Contrastive Self-Distillation (MixCSD) for intermediate representation regularization. Furthermore, we uncover a heterogeneous generation-fidelity trade-off across low-rank adapters (LoRA) and propose Selective LoRA Pruning (LoRA-SP) to adaptively prune LoRA layers, enhancing generative capability with minimal deterioration of reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HiFiPix consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art latent space methods in terms of both restoration accuracy and perceptual quality by a large margin. Code and models will be released.

papers.title_en: GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation
papers.authors: Tao Sun, Huanting Guo, Baao Xie, Zhou Fang, Qiuyu Chen, Hao Zheng, Wenjun Zeng
papers.evidence: 通过扩散特征导航实现解耦真实图像编辑
papers.tldr: 真实图像解耦编辑需兼顾因素级语义控制与保真，StyleSpace虽可解释却受GAN反演限制，扩散模型又缺乏显式解耦控制基。GeoNaviDiff以无监督跨空间框架，将StyleSpace干预迁移为扩散h空间中的局部黎曼轨迹。它用匹配的StyleGAN重建-编辑对提取球面Log映射切向量并平行移动，配合共享因素条件Navigator预测切向，以保范测地实现和源锚定rollout稳定反演。多数据集实验在保真、因素选择性、编辑局部性与轨迹平滑性上优于对比方法。
papers.abstract_en: Disentangled real-image manipulation requires factor-specific semantic control while preserving image fidelity and non-target content. StyleSpace $S$ provides interpretable controls but is limited by GAN inversion, whereas diffusion models offer stronger image realization without an explicit factorized control basis. We introduce GeoNaviDiff, an unsupervised cross-space framework that transfers disentangled StyleSpace interventions to local Riemannian trajectories in diffusion $h$-space. GeoNaviDiff constructs reconstruction-decoupled supervision by extracting a spherical Log-map tangent from a matched StyleGAN reconstruction-edit pair and parallel-transporting it to the real-image diffusion state. A shared, factor-conditioned Navigator predicts this tangent at inference, while norm-preserving geodesic realization and source-anchored rollout stabilize the reverse process without edited references or factor-specific models. Experiments across multiple datasets show that GeoNaviDiff outperforms the compared methods in fidelity, factor selectivity, edit locality, and trajectory smoothness.

papers.title_en: ACEdit: Stable Multi-Turn Image Editing via Asymmetric Conditioning
papers.authors: Sara Dorfman, Nir Goren, Gal Barak, Daniel Cohen-Or, Or Patashnik
papers.evidence: 分布漂移下稳定的多轮图像编辑
papers.tldr: 多轮图像编辑中，每轮微小的分布偏移会累积，导致编辑质量随轮次下降。ACEdit将Self-Forcing引入图像编辑，训练时让编辑器基于自身前轮输出继续编辑，并用教师编辑器蒸馏提供可靠监督。其非对称条件让学生在自生成序列上顺序编辑，教师则锚定原始干净图像并接收复合指令。实验表明长多轮序列退化显著降低，同时保持编辑质量与指令遵循。
papers.abstract_en: Image editing models produce impressive results for individual edits, but their quality often deteriorates over multiple editing turns. Each editing turn introduces small distribution shifts that accumulate over successive edits, creating a gap between the input distributions encountered during the editor's original training and multi-turn inference. We introduce a training scheme that makes multi-turn image editing stable under this accumulating distribution shift. A key is to force the editor to operate on its own outputs from previous editing turns during training, bringing the principle of Self-Forcing to image editing. The main challenge is that self-generated editing trajectories deviate from ground-truth trajectories, making direct supervision unreliable. We address this challenge through a distillation objective that leverages a teacher image editor to provide a reliable training signal when the model operates on its own previous outputs. We introduce an asymmetric conditioning scheme: while the student performs edits sequentially on its own outputs, the teacher remains anchored to the original clean image and receives a compound editing instruction. Experiments show substantially reduced degradation over long multi-turn sequences while maintaining editing quality and instruction adherence.

papers.title_en: FlashControl: One-Step Controllable Generator via Distillation-Friendly Single-Stream Teachers
papers.authors: Ngan Nguyen, Dung Nguyen, Quan Dao, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Minh Hoai, Cuong Pham, Anh Tran
papers.evidence: 通过蒸馏的一步可控扩散生成器
papers.tldr: 扩散模型在视觉生成中表现突出，但多步采样导致推理缓慢；现有一步蒸馏多聚焦文本到图像，扩展到可控生成仍受ControlNet双分支结构制约。为此，作者不增加额外条件分支，而是微调原文本到图像扩散模型的选定层，得到单流多步可控教师DeltaControl。该模型支持空间条件生成并匹配双分支方法表现，再经步蒸馏获得单前向一步生成器FlashControl。该工作降低了可控生成蒸馏难度，实现高效单步空间可控生成。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have become a leading approach in visual generative modeling, particularly effective in text-to-image and controllable generation. Their main drawback is slow inference as it requires many sampling steps. While recent distillation methods enable one-step text-to-image generation, extending these techniques to controllable generation is still challenging. Existing controllable models, such as ControlNet, rely on dual-branch design that make distillation difficult. In this work, we adopt a simpler strategy. Instead of adding extra conditional branches, we finetune a selected subset of layers in the original text-to-image diffusion model to directly enable controllable generation. This results in DeltaControl, a single-flow, multi-step diffusion model capable of supporting spatial-condition generation while matching the performance of dual-branch approaches. Building on this teacher model, we further apply step-distillation to obtain FlashControl, a one-step model capable of spatial controllable generation with a single forward pass.

papers.title_en: MTEdit: Packed Trajectories Beat Rollouts for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.authors: Houyuan Chen, Fanzhou Wang, Xiangyu Fan, Songlin Yang, Zhitao Yang, Lvmin Zhang, Pei Yang, Hao Zhao, Dahua Lin, Lei Yang, Anyi Rao
papers.evidence: 多轮图像编辑数据集与训练流程
papers.tldr: 多轮图像编辑需按连续指令修改图像，但传统顺序 rollout 会累积误差并造成跨轮视觉质量漂移。MTEdit 以打包轨迹画布 PTC 为核心生成多编辑状态，构建 500K 条、平均 5.38 轮的多轮编辑轨迹数据集。作者同时提出 MTEdit-Bench，评估指令遵循、内容一致性、抗质量漂移与历史上下文利用。基于该数据微调的 Qwen-Image-MTEdit 在开源模型中表现最佳，验证了数据管线对多轮编辑能力的提升。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, making it better aligned with human-AI collaborative creation than single-turn editing. However, constructing high-quality multi-turn training data remains challenging, as conventional sequential rollout accumulates errors and introduces visual-quality drift across editing turns. To address this challenge, we introduce MTEdit, a multi-turn image editing dataset built through a pipeline centered on packed trajectory canvas (PTC) generation. By jointly generating multiple editing states within a unified visual context, this pipeline reduces visual-quality drift across turns. Covering both step-wise and context-aware editing scenarios, MTEdit comprises 500K multi-turn image editing trajectories, with up to 8 turns and an average of 5.38 turns per trajectory, making it one of the most extensive datasets for multi-turn image editing. We further introduce MTEdit-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate both scenarios by assessing models' ability to follow editing instructions, maintain content consistency, resist visual-quality drift, and effectively use historical context across turns. Using MTEdit, we fine-tune Qwen-Image-Edit-Causal to obtain Qwen-Image-MTEdit. On MTEdit-Bench, we evaluate a broad range of closed-source and open-source image editing models, including Qwen-Image-MTEdit. Experimental results show that Qwen-Image-MTEdit achieves the best performance among the evaluated open-source models, demonstrating the effectiveness of MTEdit in improving models' multi-turn image editing capabilities.

papers.title_en: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Soumik Mukhopadhyay, Long Mai, Abhinav Shrivastava, Aniruddha Mahapatra
papers.evidence: 面向生成的像素空间扩散Transformer参数化
papers.tldr: 像素空间扩散可避开潜空间瓶颈与独立自编码器，但Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformer的参数化设计仍待厘清。本文提出MFlow，在数据主方向上自适应插值x0预测与速度预测，并与扩散训练端到端学习。实验覆盖ImageNet、UCF-101视频和文生图，性能具竞争力；同时揭示像素扩散存在高频缺失，并用冻结骨干的ConvRefiner对抗训练恢复高频统计且保持FID。
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space diffusion models have recently re-emerged as a compelling alternative to latent diffusion, avoiding the lossy latent bottleneck and separately trained autoencoder. JiT shows that a vanilla diffusion transformer can generate directly in pixel space by replacing the commonly used velocity prediction ($\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction) with clean image prediction ($\boldsymbol{x_0}$-prediction). In this work, we revisit this choice and introduce MFlow, an adaptive parameterization that learns to interpolate between $\boldsymbol{x_0}$- and $\boldsymbol{u}$-prediction across principal directions of the data, learned end-to-end with diffusion training. We find that the preferred parameterization varies systematically with the data representation and model capacity -- notably, increasing model capacity shifts preference toward velocity prediction. We evaluate MFlow across ImageNet, UCF-101 video, and large-scale text-to-image generation, demonstrating competitive or improved generative performance across diverse settings. In addition, we find that vanilla pixel diffusion transformers, irrespective of parameterization, retain a persistent high-frequency deficit relative to real images. To address this, we introduce ConvRefiner, a lightweight convolutional module trained post-hoc with an adversarial loss while keeping the diffusion backbone frozen. With only a small amount of additional training, ConvRefiner restores the high-frequency statistics of generated images while preserving FID. Project webpage: https://soumik-kanad.github.io/mflow-diffusion/.

papers.title_en: PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems
papers.evidence: 用流匹配生成先验作为即插即用逆问题求解器
papers.tldr: 连续时间深度生成先验的即插即用逆问题求解，其解质量依赖逆问题求解器与生成采样器的协同共识。PnP-CF 将 flow-matching 去噪器、类 ADMM 对偶更新和时间自适应回拉结合，回拉融合随机与确定分量以稳定迭代并促进共识。实验显示其在线性逆问题上至少媲美先进基线，并能处理含预训练神经网络前向算子的非线性逆问题，而现有方法常失败。该工作扩展 flow 型 PnP 框架至一般逆问题，凸显稳定共识机制的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

papers.title_en: GeoEdit: Adversarial De-Evidencing for Silent Geoprivacy Protection via Image Editing
papers.authors: Yu Yan, Shengjia Cheng, Fei Ma, Zhe Wang, Peng Chen
papers.evidence: 用于地理隐私保护的对抗式图像编辑框架
papers.tldr: 多模态大推理模型能借照片细节推断地理位置，带来非专家也可实施的开盒与行踪泄露风险。GeoEdit以对抗式去证据为核心，对高风险地理证据锚点做最小图像编辑，切断隐式空间推理链并保持场景语义。方法结合结构化知识与对抗挖掘定位锚点，并用可学习策略迭代优化编辑、蒸馏自然语言经验。在LifePhotoBench上对6个主流模型形成强保护，图像保真度较视觉扰动基线高出逾0.59。
papers.abstract_en: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

papers.title_en: RECAP: Reciprocal Sparse Attention and Hierarchical Caching for Efficient Video Diffusion
papers.authors: Tiange Xu, Kai Liu, Linghe Kong, Yulun Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向视频扩散的免训练稀疏注意力与分层缓存
papers.tldr: 视频扩散Transformer生成质量高但计算昂贵，稀疏注意力与时间缓存可分别降低去噪步内和跨步计算。二者直接组合会让稀疏预测误差沿采样轨迹传播。RECAP无需训练，通过互惠校正与在线误差反馈耦合稀疏注意力和分层缓存，用缓存稠密细化修正当前稀疏估计，并以新鲜稀疏统计调节校正老化。在HunyuanVideo 720p 5秒生成上取得3.05倍加速，保真度和推理速度均优于测试的直接组合。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers generate high-quality videos but remain computationally expensive. Sparse attention and temporal caching reduce computation within and across denoising steps, respectively, offering a natural composition. However, predictions produced with sparse attention become sources for temporal reuse, coupling their errors along the sampling trajectory. We observe that improving the accuracy of these sources recovers fidelity without changing the reuse schedule, and that sparsification errors remain directionally aligned across nearby steps, suggesting that correction information can be shared rather than recomputed. These observations motivate RECAP, a training-free method that couples sparse attention with hierarchical caching through reciprocal correction, adaptively coordinated by online error feedback. Cached dense refinement corrects omitted interactions in current sparse estimates, while fresh sparse statistics track input changes and regulate the aging correction. The resulting predictions then renew the sources for whole-step prediction reuse, allowing prediction history to advance between dense refreshes. We evaluate RECAP on multiple video diffusion models against sparse-attention methods, caching methods, and their direct compositions. On HunyuanVideo at 720p 5-second generation, RECAP achieves a 3.05x speedup and outperforms all tested direct compositions in both fidelity and inference speed.

papers.title_en: CheckDistill: Adaptive Checklist Distillation for Efficient Distributional Reward Modeling in Image Editing
papers.authors: Yaqi Cai, Zuan Gao, Mengting Chen, Wei Li, Bo Zheng
papers.evidence: 面向指令引导图像编辑的分布式奖励建模
papers.tldr: 针对指令引导图像编辑的强化学习奖励模型，现有标量预测压缩多维偏好，而生成式评估推理成本高且难覆盖实例约束。CheckDistill将编辑条件拆解为原子可验证要求，构建四维评分标签与结构化证据，并通过特权教师驱动的可靠性加权同策略自蒸馏，把自适应清单内化到学生评分轨迹中。部署时学生无需清单或显式推理，直接预测四维分数分布并聚合为标量奖励。在MMRB2、MER-Bench和EditReward-Bench上分别达到72.30%、56.67%和82.90%，优于开源基线。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for instruction-guided image editing requires reward models that provide reliable, accurate, and efficient feedback. Direct scalar prediction compresses multidimensional editing preferences, whereas generative evaluators can expose their judgment through explicit reasoning. However, broad scoring criteria do not specify all instance-dependent editing and preservation constraints, and generating long reasoning trajectories is costly for online optimization. We introduce CheckDistill, a pointwise reward modeling framework that internalizes instruction-adaptive checklists. We decompose each editing condition into atomic, independently verifiable requirements and construct four-dimensional scoring labels together with structured verification evidence. After supervised score initialization, a privileged teacher conditions on checklists, item-level judgments, and dimension-level rationales to supervise the student's own scoring trajectories. A reliability-weighted on-policy self-distillation objective adjusts supervision at score tokens according to agreement between the teacher's expected scores and reference labels, while retaining candidate probability weights in a truncated token support. The deployed student directly predicts four score distributions without checklist inputs or explicit reasoning and aggregates their expectations into a scalar reward. CheckDistill achieves aggregate accuracies of 72.30%, 56.67% and 82.90% on MMRB2, MER-Bench and EditReward-Bench, respectively, exceeding the compared open-source baselines on all three metrics.

papers.title_en: From Legacy to Contemporary: Scalable Color Modernization for Long Videos
papers.authors: Dongyun Kim, Jiwoo Choi, Jaeseong Lee, Seon Joo Kim
papers.evidence: 借助预训练文本引导图像编辑模型的免训练长视频色彩现代化
papers.tldr: 老视频常有色偏、彩度低、对比弱和影调失衡，人工校色难扩展到长视频多镜头。论文提出免训练框架，用预训练文本引导图像编辑联合现代化相邻关键帧网格，得到连贯参考，再以镜头专属紧凑色彩变换传播到整段镜头。在跨五十年多样老视频上，主观现代感最高，内容保真、时序稳定、感知质量和效率具竞争力，并引入SW-IGC衡量镜头间调色一致性。该工作为长视频色彩现代化提供可扩展路径与评估基准。
papers.abstract_en: Bringing legacy video back to contemporary screens does not necessarily make it look contemporary. Earlier imaging pipelines often leave color casts, muted chroma, weak con- trast, and tonal imbalance, while correcting these character- istics still relies heavily on expert colorists and scales poorly to long, multi-shot videos. We formulate long video color modernization, a task that updates the chromatic and tonal appearance of legacy color footage while preserving scene content and coherence across frames and shots. We introduce a scalable, training-free framework that jointly modernizes grids of temporally adjacent keyframes using a pretrained text-guided image editing model, producing coherent con- temporary references without paired supervision. Compact shot-specific color transforms then propagate these adjust- ments throughout each shot, preserving spatial structure and temporal stability. We conduct a multidimensional evaluation on diverse legacy videos spanning five decades. We combine a human evaluation of perceived modernness with quantita- tive measures of content fidelity, temporal stability, percep- tual quality, and efficiency, and introduce Source-Weighted Inter-shot Grade Consistency (SW-IGC) to assess grade co- herence across shots. On our evaluation set, our frame- work achieves the highest perceived modernness while re- maining competitive across complementary measures, open- ing a path toward the systematic study of long video color modernization. Code is available at https://github.com/jiwoomood/ Video_Color_Modernization.git

papers.title_en: Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models
papers.authors: Alessandro Palma, Charles Jones, Tristan Cinquin, Fabian J. Theis, Frederik Wenkel
papers.evidence: 基于轨迹回放的持续学习连续时间生成模型
papers.tldr: 持续学习中的连续时间生成模型需在不遗忘旧任务的前提下适配新数据，生成式回放因每步完整轨迹模拟而累积离散误差。本文提出轨迹回放，训练新速度场同时匹配冻结历史速度沿轨迹与当前任务速度，并按稳定性-可塑性系数加权。理论表明其最优解按密度平均两任务速度并生成概率路径混合。结合平均速度蒸馏，仅需少量网络评估即可访问历史轨迹，在类增量图像生成和两个生物案例中优于基线并保持治疗效果预测。
papers.abstract_en: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.

papers.title_en: PerQ: Inverse Generative Modeling for Neural Image Compression via Quantization Error Compensation
papers.authors: Tianhao Peng, Ho Man Kwan, Fan Zhang, Shan Liu, Dave Bull
papers.evidence: 用于感知图像重建的逆生成建模
papers.tldr: 神经图像压缩需权衡像素保真与感知质量，失真优化码流低码率易模糊，生成式码流高码率PSNR饱和且常需多模型。PerQ把感知重建视为有界支撑的逆生成建模，以量化单元约束重建，并在冻结多率失真优化主干上接码率条件流匹配补偿器。在Kodak与CLIC2020上，其LPIPS和FID接近MS-ILLM，PSNR与ELIC相当，单检查点覆盖宽码率且解码快。该工作用量化误差补偿提升感知质量，并验证跨三种主干的稳定增益。
papers.abstract_en: Neural image codecs face a fundamental trade-off between pixel fidelity and perceptual quality. Distortion-optimized codecs preserve pixel-wise fidelity but produce blurred reconstructions at low bitrates, whereas generative codecs leverage learned priors to improve perceptual quality but tend to exhibit saturating PSNR at higher bitrates and require separate models for different bitrate targets. We propose PerQ, which reframes perceptual reconstruction as inverse generative modeling with bounded support. Specifically, we define the quantization cell as the set of latents that yield the same transmitted symbols and derive a transport bound showing that reconstructions from this cell remain within a rate-determined radius of the codec output. This motivates performing generative reconstruction within the codec-induced quantization cell, rather than sampling from an unconstrained image prior. PerQ implements this principle by attaching a rate-conditioned flow-matching compensator to a frozen, multi-rate distortion-optimized backbone, enabling perceptual enhancement while preserving the backbone's coding performance. Experiments on Kodak and CLIC2020 show that PerQ achieves perceptual performance comparable to generative codecs such as MS-ILLM in LPIPS and FID, while maintaining competitive PSNR relative to distortion-optimized codecs such as ELIC. A single model checkpoint supports a wide bitrate range with fast decoding, and the compensator provides consistent gains across three different backbones. The implementation is available at https://jasminepp.github.io/PerQ/.
